summary: A board rule leaves the librarian on duty to decide when to interrupt a patron.
realLife: Greenville trustees expected library staff to learn South Carolina's obscenity law and intervene when use of the computers violated the policy.
inGame: needs: adopted rule and staff responsibility.

turns.what: The librarian asks for a second judgment before approaching the reader.
turns.writesBack: The supervisor shares responsibility for the decision.

turns.pulledBy: The branch has no supervisor on duty.
turns.what: The librarian asks the board for a clearer procedure.
turns.writesBack: The next policy discussion includes lone desk coverage.
